The CUDA custody core is implemented and boundedly CPU-qualified at R89: 1,515 unique root passes, including 67 core cases repeated independently. Production local-GPU contracts remain empty; producer integration, real CUDA execution and programme acceptance remain open.

BAC has **28 qualified releases out of the original 66 packages**, with **38 original packages still requiring qualification**. WIP17 publishes independently reviewed CUDA-core CPU behavior and evidence, retaining earlier replay and owner qualification. This is bounded component delivery, not a package closure or whole-BAC release.
# Current position

Native state and gradients are captured together, saved native configuration is reconstructed offside, required owners stay alive through publication, and final currency plus uncertain-completion checks fail closed. | Legal action selection and successor masks, completed-lane action gating, uniform and prioritized replay, real short windows, matching PER estimators, recurrent PER, production collection and learner readiness | T08, T08a, T09, T09a, T10, T11, T12, T13, T14, T15 |
| Effective runner warmup, descriptor/value interactions, bounded RND service and tails, count novelty, ICM, completion envelopes and clock ledger | T16, T17, T18, T18b, T18c, T19 |
| Explicit curiosity scope and seeds, private RNG foundations, recording work that survives shutdown | PW01, PW02, T33 |
Later accepted component work is tracked separately:

- **Curriculum and world foundations:** completion-driven curriculum and option/factory producers, compiled roster and identity/state maintenance, and world-state owner components. Their actual joint runtime routing remains open.

- **Provider construction and service:** typed events and local clocks, RNG binding, the five-provider factory and separate policy selector; RND, ICM and adaptive providers perform real updates using their declared local service and native-state contracts.

- **Private curiosity bank:** independently owned state for all five provider families, local replay and service, completion publication and failure custody. - **Same-scope checkpoint component:** off-side validation and preparation of models, gradients, optimizer, RNG, clocks, phases, caches and history; strict identity checks, owned installation and current replay-component preservation. It passed 147 root and 147 independent cases, with 635 covering passes and three CUDA skips. These overlapping selections are not added together.

These bank and checkpoint results use bounded component fixtures. They do not prove complete DQN/runner parent admission, captured replay sampling or ordinary end-to-end resume. The [published qualification evidence](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/30a802a996fe8bf7cd63e53d211fa8b2cd028f77/docs/remediation/bac/evidence/wave34-wip-01.json) and [runtime contract](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/30a802a996fe8bf7cd63e53d211fa8b2cd028f77/docs/remediation/bac/CURRENT-EXPLORATION-RUNTIME-CONTRACT.md) record the reviewed runtime component and current curriculum consumer repair. The runtime component passed 150 independent tests and a coherent 1,123-pass selection with three CUDA skips, plus independent source/specification and documentation truth review. The repair uses the real completed-event API, with no compatibility-only adapter: 52 migrated cases and 175 event regressions passed, for 227 passes. Compiler CLI validation also passed for 34 packs across 35 processes with verified source, import and thread identities. The subsequent full-repository run at the exact pushed source failed after 2,003.7499 seconds. Verification covered 797 source files, 573 configurations, 13 artifacts, all five pytest processes, the index and registry custody; the separately verified poisoning child also passed its assertions. Failure triage identifies 1,241 deduplicated failed test-node/phase records across 160 affected source files and 15 terminal-signature groups, chiefly missing world-identity constructor inputs, required reservation/activation, old curriculum/provider calls and stale option/schema assertions. These records are not 1,241 independent algorithmic defects. Repair causal prerequisites until tests reach their intended assertions before another broad run. The failed baseline and triage are now published in the [earlier checkpoint evidence](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/31beef58892fe651daf6c9965f372b3643523ce2/docs/remediation/bac/evidence/wave35-wip-01.json). The [intrinsic-scale composer contract](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/31beef58892fe651daf6c9965f372b3643523ce2/docs/remediation/bac/CURRENT-INTRINSIC-SCALE-COMPOSER-CONTRACT.md) records the new bounded math/API component: raw reward 2 × scale 0.5 × weight 0.25 × modifier 2 produces intrinsic reward 0.5 and total reward 1.6 in the tested case. These checks do not establish current full-repository or all-family end-to-end qualification. The [new published evidence](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/1938f7cac6dca6ecb31952c9f31cc74248024dd0/docs/remediation/bac/evidence/wave35-wip-02.json) and [canonical reward-flow contract](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/1938f7cac6dca6ecb31952c9f31cc74248024dd0/docs/remediation/bac/CURRENT-CANONICAL-REWARD-FLOW-CONTRACT.md) now record actual environment-to-parent delivery. The same 75 cases passed independently with no errors, skips or warnings: all five families and both scopes, phase and identity transport, canonical replay, pre-physics claim, real active-effect and pending-cancellation cases, retirement, and the original single-batch commitment/reset failure controls. Actual raw reward 2 × scale 0.5 × weight 0.25 × modifier 2 produced intrinsic reward 0.5 and total 1.6. A late runtime/callback rebinding defect was found and repaired; nine binding cases pass. Current compiler CLI validation passed 34 packs across 35 verified processes in 152.12084 seconds. These bounded results do not qualify complete native restore, genuine end-to-end learning or an integrated package release.

Every one of the 38 original packages still awaiting qualification appears once below. Some contain accepted components; each still owes its full package behavior and integration evidence.

Complete real native-parent and runner integration and full package qualification, preserving source archives, compatible state and truthful origin/counter semantics. |
| Runtime curiosity routing — T18d, T18e, PW08a, PW08, T18f | Complete population, runner and native-parent integration around the reviewed runtime and canonical environment reward flow. The primitive's 29-case proof, published 75-case environment/parent checkpoint and later 78-case selection are bounded evidence. Original commitment/reset findings and the additional exact multi-batch retry and prepare/install binding defects are repaired and independently approved within their tested limits. Native learning reset is implemented in the three model providers and independently source/API approved; its 61 cases pass within the now-published coherent 139-case run. The shared/private RNG custody core is now boundedly qualified at 11ec9885. WIP14 now qualifies bounded CPU BANK/checkpoint adoption of domain-before-lock custody, authentic lineage, atomic native/gradient capture, saved-native restoration, owner lifetime and final currency. All five families and both scopes have restored-learning and equal-authentic-input BANK witnesses. Full native-parent correlation, enrolled direct consumers, joint publication and the ordinary runner remain open. The earlier _Run/VFS fixture checkpoint had 298 passes and four unqualified CUDA skips; the new core API requires current-owner requalification. Its world-only transport did not establish full native learner restore. The initial-participation environment producer now has 57 root and 57 overlapping independent passes at 7a96f86d. The additional read-only environment participation validator is now implemented and reviewed at 00889036, with 80 root and 80 overlapping independent passes; active validation remains unchanged. The population consumer, private pre-Q seal and owned public-query checks are now implemented and reviewed at d152425f. Its bounded proof includes active-world learning/replay, inactive-world privacy, mixed closure and the next cycle. Broader mixed-participation coverage, stable role-owner completed restore, native transfer/reset and history/cache/clock correlation remain required. Complete broader environment and lifecycle witnesses, captured-replay learning and ordinary checkpoint smoke before package qualification. |
| Curriculum integration — T20, T21, T22, T23 | Integrate accepted curriculum producers and provenance, implement per-world dynamics, and prove each world's completion and controller decisions reach its own mechanics through population and runner. |

| Outputs and diagnostics — T34, T35, T36, PW11 | Own recorder failures during runner cleanup; preserve sink units and outcomes, effective hyperparameters and intervention reporting, and per-world scope, origin and scale diagnostics. A scalar summary must never replace per-world reward scales. |
| Isolation and lifecycle proof — PW12, PW13, PW14, PW15 | Inventory actual simulator state owners; prove private rewards and state across real curiosity updates, reset/resume/conversion and archived history; verify each controller lane and the declared shared-Q feedback boundary. |
| Joint acceptance and learning — T37, T38, T39, PW16, T40 | Complete learning-support, restart/transfer/serve/discovery and persisted-output matrices; prove truthful shared/private support and run the finite original learning protocol plus the strict cohort after integrity gates pass. |
# Next delivery steps

1. Begin producer A classification after the durable WIP17 checkpoint: A flat/PER producer integration, B exact source-owned core activation and separate core/test ownership plus independent review, C recurrent producer integration, then D exact activation with its separate core/test review. Preserve the five-body/5,000-line limit; the current combined five production bodies total5,017 and require fresh bounded slices. The stage-specific empty-manifest assertion and actual resolver/cache guard coverage must be updated at activation without weakening authorization. Continue external BANK/ENV/POP/native/runner integration, full current-parent restoration and joint all-child publication/failure handling, preserving genuine sampling/readiness and learning, current authority and owner lifetime.

2. Repair and qualify the required ordinary runner/oracle integration, direct-consumer enrollment, stable-role/full-D behavior and T26 durability. The known ordinary-runner case was excluded only from R72's bounded selection and remains required. Preserve saved native/optimizer/gradient configuration, SOURCE archive/TARGET initialization semantics, bare-Adam/manual-replacement/signed-offset support and alias-quiescence boundaries. C10/K01 do not require independent exact simulator trajectory continuation.

3. Resolve the exact WIP16 remote mypy failures through genuine current owner/caller contracts: six oracle-driver errors and nine missing-lineage errors in population replay preparation/install/sampling calls. Preserve scripted RNG/mechanics and pinned-reference capability. WIP16 Ruff and Black passed; defaults was skipped after mypy failed. Complete full/default, coverage, slow, applicable hardware, learning, final 54-requirement/22-lens review and exact-final-remote CI; bounded passes do not establish final acceptance.
4. Finish curriculum, checkpoint/restart, transfer/serving and diagnostics packages in dependency order, followed by the complete isolation and joint acceptance evidence.
# Final completion criteria

- All **54 effective requirements**, **22 fresh final design and implementation review lenses**, and independent synthesis pass on the final common immutable source, with no unresolved P1/P2 findings or unapproved in-scope gaps.

- Real runtime evidence covers all four Q families, all five curiosity providers and both scopes through compilation, rollout, updates, save/load and serving. Private isolation uses real local learning and complete named state owners, including lifecycle and controlled shared-Q cases.

- The original T40 learning protocol is retained. The additional strict cohort is exactly **12 runs**: four families × seeds 11, 29 and 47, each with 10,000 eligible training transitions and 20 evaluation episodes per seed, using explicit per-world adaptive RND and actual local predictor updates. Record controls, metrics, failures and deviations; do not infer a causal shared/private comparison from differing settings.

- Required default full-repository, coverage of at least 70%, slow, applicable hardware, static and exact-final-remote CI checks pass. Source-verified documentation and supported end-to-end scenarios agree with the actual behavior.

The [accepted per-world requirements](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/a7c4cd0b19c410114aaabdd9284888fef159e84e/docs/remediation/bac/PER-WORLD-CURIOSITY-ADDENDUM.md) define the finite isolation and learning obligations. Current tracking reflects later accepted amendments, including the 54-requirement and 22-lens totals.
# Decisions and boundaries

**No user decision blocks current CPU integration work.** The offered16-worker CUDA server is expected later, but access, resources and GPU count are not yet verified. The implemented CUDA custody core is boundedly CPU-qualified; its production local-GPU manifest is empty and real hardware execution remains UNRUN. Astra's accepted additive design and finite producer slices preserve lazy construction, dynamic unindexed device selection, exact device inventory, owner exclusion through completion and currentness. Root allocates runners only after actual CPU/RAM/GPU/source measurement, with bounded job/device concurrency and immutable process/receipt custody. One GPU cannot qualify two-device selection/retention/completion. Preserve historical hashed helpers and attempts. Hardware availability alone closes no gate. Strict per-world curiosity is required, with the explicit shared alternative preserved; omitted scope retains shared behavior. Shared Q and policy feedback remain permitted under the declared controlled-trace isolation guarantee.

Current producers, callers, tests and documentation evolve together without legacy adapters or compatibility loaders. Preserve historical artifacts, backups, source archives and current captured replay. C10/K01's simulator-continuation deferral remains explicit. The [current evidence index](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/9acd85d3ccd897051288a13fd16e610b9ee1fca1/docs/remediation/bac/EVIDENCE-INDEX.md), [WIP17 manifest](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/9acd85d3ccd897051288a13fd16e610b9ee1fca1/docs/remediation/bac/evidence/wave35-wip-17.json) and [evidence process](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/9acd85d3ccd897051288a13fd16e610b9ee1fca1/docs/remediation/bac/EVIDENCE-PROCESS.md) publish58 checks,68 attempts,64 result commands and4 UNRUN specs, plus a separate capture failure. These are evidence/command counts, not unique tests. Nine ACTUAL LATE generic verifications add no tests; all10 batch strong-rejection attempts remain retained. Publication retains489 objects:470 new /4,690,563 bytes and19 reused, with834 logical aliases. Final terminal FIX2 review556e7056 approved the bounded evidence account. Manifest SHA-256200b1696604ce4f9388c99fec22b3afa8c0edcfb95ee438632a339530d0f9226; plan5a01cc361f55d978e7b3808095fc4a61a1ce6c4b0229b863caf9e5dc598b09e6; final receipt a072ce25c32ce1bc713f86e61ac1d60ed6a35e9e60fdbc042fdf87867137b5b7; exact remote verification422a4f24fbcd894584c4cec636a7886a4335a7f3f65e73dc63a06e00007c31cc. [WIP16 evidence](https://github.com/foundryside-dev/hamlet/blob/e880ab6bd3bd8ec6c16ee6c5ace123b2ed1b6a32/docs/remediation/bac/evidence/wave35-wip-16.json) retains R82 genuine RED and fixture failures, R83 prerequisite corrections, R84's failed owner gate, R85's qualified repair and its exact failed publication attempts; earlier checkpoints remain unchanged.
